_readme: Copy the 'mcpServers' block into ~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json then restart Claude Desktop.

research-panel-manager._readme_command: Full path to uv — run `which uv` in your terminal to find yours.
research-panel-manager._readme_args: uv downloads Python 3.11 automatically and installs the three packages listed with --with. The last arg is the absolute path to mcp_server.py.
